overviews.name: TRANTYPE
key_points: Maintains the transaction type reference table in Db2, online through a list screen and an add/update screen and in batch from an update file.
Creates and seeds the transaction type and transaction type category tables, and unloads both to sequential extract files, keeping the previous extracts as backup generations.

descriptions.name: CBTRNDYN
descriptions.description: Ad-hoc maintenance driver: runs one SQL statement read from DYNSQL with PREPARE/EXECUTE, then dynamically CALLs the program named in its PARM.
key_points: Concatenates the non-comment DYNSQL records into one statement and runs it as dynamic SQL; a failed PREPARE or negative EXECUTE SQLCODE sets return code 8.
When a PARM is present it CALLs the program named there; the name is not known at compile time.

descriptions.name: COBTUPDT
descriptions.description: Batch maintenance of CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE: applies add, update and delete records read from INPFILE.
key_points: Each INPFILE record carries an action (A, U, D, or * for a comment), a two-character type and a 50-character description.
A negative SQLCODE, or +100 on update or delete, displays a message and sets return code 4; an insert has no +100 branch.

descriptions.name: COTRTLIC
descriptions.description: CICS screen (transaction CTLI) that lists transaction types from Db2 with paging and lets the user update or delete rows.
key_points: Pages forward and backward through CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE with two cursors, seven rows per screen.
PF2 transfers to the add/update program COTRTUPC; PF3 transfers back to the calling program or the admin menu.

descriptions.name: COTRTUPC
descriptions.description: CICS screen (transaction CTTU) that fetches one transaction type and lets the user add, change or delete it in Db2.
key_points: Selects, updates, inserts and deletes rows of CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE, asking for confirmation with PF5 (save) and PF4 (delete).
PF3 transfers back to the calling program, or to the admin menu when no caller is recorded in the COMMAREA.

descriptions.name: CREADB2
descriptions.description: Sets up the Db2 side: frees the old plans, creates the CARDDEMO database, tables and indexes, and loads the type and category reference rows.
key_points: FREEPLN runs the DB2FREE cards, CRCRDDB runs the DB2CREAT DDL, RUNTEP2 and LDTCCAT run the DB2LTTYP and DB2LTCAT inserts.

descriptions.name: MNTTRDB2
descriptions.description: Runs COBTUPDT under plan CARDDEMO to insert, update or delete transaction type rows from the INPFILE input.

descriptions.name: MNTTRDYN
descriptions.description: Ad-hoc maintenance: runs CBTRNDYN under plan CARDDEMO with the SQL in DYNSQL and PARMS('COBTUPDT'), with INPFILE also allocated.

descriptions.name: TRANEXTR
descriptions.description: Backs up the previous transaction type and category extract files to GDGs, deletes them, and unloads both Db2 tables again with DSNTIAUL.
key_points: STEP10 and STEP20 copy TRANTYPE.PS and TRANCATG.PS to new backup generations; STEP30 deletes both files.
STEP40 and STEP50 unload TRANSACTION_TYPE and TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY as 60-byte records into the two files.
